subfeatures.name: Decrease Indent
subfeatures.what_it_does: Moves the paragraph's left indent one level toward the margin.
subfeatures.behavior: Direct action: Moves the paragraph's left indent one level toward the margin. Applied immediately to the paragraph's left indent; toggle state (where applicable) is reflected by the button's highlighted look.

connections.why: both change the paragraph's left indent

subfeatures.name: Increase Indent
subfeatures.what_it_does: Moves the paragraph's left indent one level away from the margin.
subfeatures.behavior: Direct action: Moves the paragraph's left indent one level away from the margin. Applied immediately to the paragraph's left indent; toggle state (where applicable) is reflected by the button's highlighted look.

connections.why: both change the paragraph's left indent

subfeatures.name: Sort
subfeatures.what_it_does: Opens the Sort dialog to alphabetically/numerically sort the selected paragraphs, list or table.
subfeatures.affects: the order of the selected paragraphs

subfeatures.name: Show/Hide ¶
subfeatures.what_it_does: Toggles the on-screen display of paragraph marks and other hidden formatting symbols.
subfeatures.affects: the view (formatting marks visibility) — not the document
subfeatures.behavior: Direct action: Toggles the on-screen display of paragraph marks and other hidden formatting symbols. Applied immediately to the view (formatting marks visibility) — not the document; toggle state (where applicable) is reflected by the button's highlighted look.

subfeatures.name: Align Left
subfeatures.what_it_does: Aligns the paragraph text to the left margin.
subfeatures.behavior: Direct action: Aligns the paragraph text to the left margin. Applied immediately to the paragraph's alignment; toggle state (where applicable) is reflected by the button's highlighted look. Appears as four horizontal lines aligned to the left.

subfeatures.name: Center
subfeatures.what_it_does: Centers the paragraph text between the margins.
subfeatures.behavior: Direct action: Centers the paragraph text between the margins. Applied immediately to the paragraph's alignment; toggle state (where applicable) is reflected by the button's highlighted look. Appears as four horizontal lines centered.

subfeatures.name: Align Right
subfeatures.what_it_does: Aligns the paragraph text to the right margin.
subfeatures.behavior: Direct action: Aligns the paragraph text to the right margin. Applied immediately to the paragraph's alignment; toggle state (where applicable) is reflected by the button's highlighted look. Appears as four horizontal lines aligned to the right.

subfeatures.name: Justify
subfeatures.what_it_does: Spaces the paragraph text to align to both left and right margins.
subfeatures.behavior: Direct action: Spaces the paragraph text to align to both left and right margins. Applied immediately to the paragraph's alignment; toggle state (where applicable) is reflected by the button's highlighted look. Appears as four horizontal lines flush to both margins.

subfeatures.name: Line and Paragraph Spacing
subfeatures.what_it_does: Sets the spacing between lines and before/after paragraphs.
subfeatures.behavior: Opens Line and Paragraph Spacing (menu). Contents (9 controls): 1.0, 1.15, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5, 3.0, Add Space Before Paragraph, Remove Space After Paragraph, Line Spacing Options….
